about: What readers type, by article: their own words, questions and complaints. Help's search treats each as a keyword of that article, and the command palette doesn't see them. When a reader's words miss an article, add them here, spelled correctly: search mends typos itself, and it never learns a word from this file. src/help/search.heldout.test.ts says which queries you must never tune on.
